skins.name: For the Banquet
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/For the Banquet
skins.description: Melanite once attended a banquet hosting people from across the industry. On careful consideration, she chose this gown to hide her true purpose for attending.

skins.name: Laminar Flow
skins.description: Clothes Underflow wore to the theater in Ægir. Lightweight armor and a tailored skirt come together to form a balance between comfort and defense.

skins.name: Fragrant Pace
skins.description: A jacket and skirt woven by Dahuang 's weavers for the festivities, gifted to Grain Buds to wear as she wanders the fields. Around her, the wonders of nature. By her side, fine friends to be sure.

skins.name: I Am the Tides
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/I Am the Tides
skins.description: An outfit Gladiia often wears. With the tides, she comes and goes freely between land and sea. The hunter is at ease, for the hunter is the tide.

skins.name: Scribing
skins.description: The dust settles, the noise stops, and Nuova Volsinii finally quiets down. Here, the judge sheds her robes of the law, and with pen in hand, she writes of the turmoil that once rocked Siracusa .
